name: SPIEL Essen
blurb: The world's largest public board-game fair, four days of new releases, publisher booths and an Artist Alley at Messe Essen.

editions.evidence: Homepage banner: 'SPIEL ESSEN 22. - 25. OCT 2026'; footer: 'ON THE FAIR GROUND OF MESSE ESSEN 22 – 24th Oct 2026 (Thu – Sat) from 10am to 7pm 25th Oct 2026 (Sun) from 10am to 6pm'.

notes: A publisher/exhibitor trade-and-public fair, not an autograph-guest convention; the only named figure on the homepage is illustrator Peter Mohrbacher as the 2026 event 'ambassador' (a single promotional role, not a guest roster), so guests is 'none'.
